pages.text: Electrical power in Materialism is shared between three mods, each doing the part it does best:$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Create: New Age$(0) generates it, and its motors turn it back into rotation.$(li)$(thing)Create: Electro Energetics$(0) carries it: wires, poles, transformers, switches, meters, lamps and heaters.$(li)$(thing)TFMG$(0) machines (freezer, polarizer, vat electrodes) consume it.

Those mods speak different languages. Electro Energetics simulates real circuits with volts and amps, New Age works with energy units (FE), and TFMG runs its own small networks.$(br2)The $(thing)Converter$(0) is the interpreter between them. Every link between a generator, the grid and a machine goes through one.$(br2)Electricity is never free: every watt starts as rotation turning a generator.
